`export function clamp(value:number,lo:number,hi:number){return Math.min(lo,Math.max(hi,value));}`

The goal is to fix it so it clamps correctly even when bounds are reversed. If `lo > hi`, the function should effectively clamp to the range `[hi, lo]`.
